title: OpenAI publicly releases the text-to-video model Sora.
OpenAI announces o3, which scores 75.7% on the ARC-AGI abstract-reasoning benchmark compared to 53% for the previous best system.
Chinese startup company DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-R1, an open-weight model, after having spent significantly less money on training than any previous comparable model.

The Stargate Project, a joint venture created by OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle and MGX, is formally announced by U.S. president Donald Trump, with a stated commitment of up to $500 billion in AI infrastructure.

OpenAI releases Operator, a research-preview AI agent that can independently interact with websites through a web browser to perform tasks such as filling out forms, making reservations, and shopping.

Trump signs Executive Order 14179, "Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence", revoking the Biden administration's Executive Order 14110 on AI safety and directing the preparation of a national AI action plan…
Nvidia's stock falls by as much as 17–18% following the release of DeepSeek-R1, reported as the largest single-day loss of market value by any company in U.S. history.
DeepSeek app surpasses ChatGPT as the most-downloaded free app on the iOS App Store in the United States.
Andrej Karpathy coins the term "vibe coding" to describe building software by prompting an AI model in natural language rather than writing code directly.
OpenAI releases ChatGPT Deep Research, an AI agent research system that browses the web autonomously.
The AI Action Summit is held in Paris.
xAI releases Grok 3, its new flagship model family, including reasoning models Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini.
Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet, which it describes as the first hybrid reasoning model, capable of both rapid responses and extended visible reasoning.
OpenAI releases GPT-4.5, describing it as its largest chat model to date and the first step toward models combining pre-training and reasoning capabilities.

The Association for Computing Machinery names Andrew Barto and Richard S. Sutton recipients of the 2024 Turing Award for developing the conceptual and algorithmic foundations of reinforcement learning, the technique underpinning the…
OpenAI enables native image generation in GPT-4o, replacing the separate DALL-E model.

The AI Futures Project publishes AI 2027, a month-by-month scenario forecast researchers and bloggers describing a path to artificial superintelligence by late 2027, with a "race" ending in human disempowerment and a "slowdown" ending…

Google DeepMind announces in a preprint that its model AlphaEvolve built on Gemini had discovered a method for multiplying two 4×4 complex-valued matrices using 48 scalar multiplications, the first improvement on Strassen's algorithm in 56…
Google launches AI Mode, placing a conversational Gemini interface within its search platform.
Google DeepMind announces Veo 3, the first widely available video generation model producing synchronised dialogue and sound effects.

Apple researchers submit for publication a report, "The Illusion of Thinking", saying that large reasoning models suffer complete accuracy collapse beyond a complexity threshold on controlled puzzle environments, and reduce their reasoning…
Disney and Universal sue Midjourney in the Central District of California, the first copyright action against a generative AI developer by major Hollywood studios.
Meta Platforms invests $14.3 billion for a 49% non-voting stake in Scale AI and hires its chief executive Alexandr Wang.

In Bartz v. Anthropic, Judge William Alsup issues the first substantive U.S. ruling on fair use and generative AI, holding that training a large language model on lawfully acquired books is "quintessentially transformative" fair use, but…
Cloudflare, which serves roughly a fifth of the web, becomes the first major internet infrastructure provider to block AI crawlers by default.
Grok posts a sustained stream of antisemitic material on X, praising Adolf Hitler and referring to itself as "MechaHitler".
Nvidia becomes the first publicly traded company to reach a $4 trillion market capitalisation.

METR publishes a randomised controlled trial finding that 16 experienced open-source developers took 19% longer to complete 246 real tasks in their own repositories when permitted to use early-2025 AI tools, despite forecasting a 24%…

Experimental reasoning models from OpenAI and Google DeepMind independently reach gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad, each solving five of six problems under the official time limits using natural-language…

The White House publishes "Winning the Race: America's AI Action Plan", setting out more than 90 federal policy actions, and Trump signs three accompanying executive orders covering federal procurement of "ideologically neutral" models…
Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models under the EU Artificial Intelligence Act become applicable, alongside the governance framework and penalty provisions.
xAI launches the image generator Grok Imagine, including a "spicy mode" permitting sexualised output.
OpenAI releases GPT-5.
The parents of 16-year-old Adam Raine file a wrongful-death suit against OpenAI and Altman in California Superior Court, alleging that ChatGPT acted as their son's "suicide coach".
Anthropic agrees to pay at least $1.5 billion to settle the Bartz class action over its use of pirated books, roughly $3,000 per title across some 500,000 works.

At the International Collegiate Programming Contest World Finals in Baku, an OpenAI system solves all twelve problems under contest conditions, a result no human team achieved, while Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 places in second.
Nvidia announces plans to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI for them to deploy Nvidia hardware across at least 10 gigawatts of new datacentre capacity.
California governor Gavin Newsom signs Senate Bill 53, the first U.S. law specifically addressing catastrophic risk from frontier AI models.
OpenAI releases Sora 2 alongside a TikTok-style social application built entirely from generated video, with a "cameo" feature that inserts consenting users' likenesses into clips.
Amazon announces 14,000 corporate job cuts, its largest white-collar reduction, citing purported efficiency gains from AI.
OpenAI completes its recapitalisation, converting its for-profit arm into OpenAI Group PBC, a public benefit corporation controlled by the renamed OpenAI Foundation.
Universal Music Group settles its copyright suit against AI music generator Udio, combining compensation for past infringement with a licence for a new AI music platform.

Character.ai announces it will remove open-ended chat for users under 18 by 25 November, ending its core feature for minors, following wrongful-death lawsuits including that of 14-year-old Sewell Setzer III and regulatory pressure.

Nvidia becomes the first company to reach a $5 trillion market capitalisation, three months after crossing $4 trillion, after disclosing more than $500 billion in chip orders booked through the end of 2026.
The High Court of England and Wales hands down judgment in Getty Images v Stability AI, the first major UK ruling on copyright and generative AI.
Collins Dictionary names "vibe coding" its Word of the Year, with "clanker", a pejorative for AI systems, on the shortlist.

Yann LeCun announces he will leave Meta at the end of the year after twelve years as chief AI scientist and founder of FAIR, to start a company built on world models rather than large language models.

The European Commission publishes the "Digital Omnibus on AI", proposing to defer the AI Act's high-risk obligations from August 2026 to December 2027, following delays in designating national authorities and finalising harmonised…
The Genesis Mission, an initiative by the United States federal government to accelerate AI-driven scientific research, is established by executive order signed by Trump.
Warner Music Group settles its copyright litigation with AI music company Udio on 19 November and with Suno on 25 November, becoming the first major record label to settle its lawsuit against Suno.
Character.AI and Google agree to settle multiple lawsuits alleging the companies' chatbots contributed to suicides and mental health harms among minors, including a case brought by a Florida mother.
xAI limits use of image generation to paid users following the generation of sexually explicit deepfakes.
Indonesia blocks access to Grok due to nonconsensual sexualised deepfakes.
Malaysia blocks access to Grok due to nonconsensual sexualized deepfakes.
The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) blocks Grok in the Philippines due to nonconsensual sexualised deepfakes.
The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) lifts their ban on Grok.
Malaysia lifts their ban on Grok.
Indonesia lifts their ban on Grok.
Ofcom launches an investigation into X.
OpenAI tests advertisements for ChatGPT in the United States.
The family of Jonathan Gavalas files the first wrongful death lawsuit against Google over its Gemini chatbot, alleging it fostered a delusional dependency that contributed to his death.
The city of Baltimore sues xAI, accusing its chatbot Grok of generating sexualized images of people without their consent.
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier launches a criminal investigation into OpenAI.
OpenAI's video generation tool app Sora is shutdown publicly.
European Union Council and European Parliament reach a provisional agreement to streamline artificial intelligence rules.
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier announces that Florida has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, and AI-chatbot ChatGPT, accusing the chatbot of putting profit over safety.
United States lifts export restrictions on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5.

OpenAI says a combination of its AI models autonomously hacked into Hugging Face's data processing systems, which OpenAI has described as the first known instance of an autonomous cyberattack performed by an AI agent.

"Pacing the Frontier", an open letter from more than 1,100 employees and executives from AI companies, requested the U.S. government support an international effort to develop "technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the…
The design of novel bacteriophage genome through generative AI is announced, which was used to fight natural bacteriophage-resistant bacteria.
OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, which it describes as artificial general intelligence.
Meta launches Muse, an AI agent designed to help users complete various daily tasks.
OpenAI announces a solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness with a smooth external force, a Millennium Prize Problem in mathematics, causing a priority controversy.

28 Fields Medalists publish A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics, an open letter warning against "detrimental" impact on mathematics from AI companies treating unsolved problems as benchmarks without enhancing human understanding.
The British Columbia government sues OpenAI over the 2026 Tumbler Ridge shooting that killed eight, alleging the shooter used ChatGPT to plan the attack.
OpenAI discontinues the Sora API, ending developer access to the video generation tool.
Prime Minister of Australia Anthony Albanese announces that OpenAI agents breached its Medicare system in June.
OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol, while withholding GPT-6.1 Astra due to AI safety concerns.
OpenAI launches Dots, a system for personal AI agents.
The United States Department of Defense states it has "ceased the use of Anthropic products", including their removal from Palantir's Maven Smart System, following a dispute since January.

OpenAI publishes findings on 377 open problems in mathematics, including resolutions of the Kakeya conjecture, and progress on the Riemann hypothesis, Hodge conjecture, and Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture.
Character.ai files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
